notes:
Company context:
- SaaS contact-center provider that powers chat for ~120 enterprise customers. Core product is an omnichannel ticketing + routing platform.
- Heavy cost pressure: average 200k incoming chat messages/day; peak bursts up to 8k/min during promotions. Goal: deflect 30-40% of chats to bot flows and save on live-agent spend.

Workload & requirements (from discovery):
- Primary workloads: high-volume deflection (batchable summaries + KB retrieval), agent assist (context + suggested replies), ticket summarization for post-chat transcripts, and tool-calling (CRM writes, escalate).
- Latency targets: 95p < 400ms for assistant suggestions; user-visible deflection path target < 600ms end-to-end.
- Throughput target: sustained 3k reqs/min; burst handling expected up to 8k/min with graceful degradation.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost per deflected conversation <$0.02 (unit economics modeled vs human agent $1.50/min). Need clear token-unit economics.
- Model preferences: open models + quantized variants acceptable. Want option to route low-risk queries to quantized 8-bit models and escalate to higher-quality fp16 for ambiguous cases.
- Routing/fallback: need policy-based routing by latency/cost/region; automatic fallback to smaller models when capacity constrained.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency SLOs, and end-to-end tracing for tool-calls.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for all tool calls, KMS integration for keys, EU data residency for several customers.

POC ask & success criteria:
- 2-week POC on Dedicated capacity (2-node GPU pool) to validate throughput, batching and KV-cache hit rates, and cost projections.
- Deliverables: throughput test report (QPS/95p latency), batching/cache savings simulation, projected monthly unit cost at 200k msgs/day, demo of tool-calling flow with audit logs.
- Acceptance: demonstrate stable 95p latency < 450ms under 3k reqs/min and cost projection that meets <$0.02 per deflected conversation when using batching + quantized model mix.
